context: Two teens debrief a chaotic gym class
purpose: Teach: 尻/舌/裸/途端/ご存じ/突っ込ん/わざと/いまいち

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今日の体育、走った途端、転んで尻めっちゃ痛い。
lines.en: I totally ate pavement in gym today—the second I started running I just went down, and my butt's killing me.
lines.style: Sharp, self-deprecating opening. Quick pace on the crash part. Slight whine on the pain admission, but playful about it. Not looking for sympathy, just airing it out.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: マジか。先生にわざとじゃないって言った?
lines.en: Seriously? Did you at least tell the teacher it was an accident?
lines.style: Genuine concern underneath the casual delivery. Leans in slightly with the question. Warm but not fussy—just checking she's okay.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん。隣の子も突っ込んできて、私の舌噛みかけたんだよ。
lines.en: Yeah, and this kid next to me totally crashed into me too. I almost bit my own tongue off.
lines.style: Animated, building energy as she stacks on the details. Slight exaggeration on the tongue part—mock-dramatic. Talking with her hands.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ご存じの通り、あいつ走るの下手だしな。
lines.en: I mean, that guy can barely run anyway.
lines.style: Dry, knowing half-smile in the voice. Gentle roast—not mean, just stating the obvious. Relaxed, conspiratorial.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 家帰ったら、裸足で氷踏みたい気分だわ。
lines.en: Honestly, when I get home I just want to stand barefoot on ice for like an hour.
lines.style: Tired but not defeated. Sighing undertone on the opening word. Slow drawl on 'barefoot ice'—painting the image. Small laugh at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 体育の点、いまいちのまま終わりそうだな。
lines.en: Yeah, my gym grade's probably gonna stay in the gutter.
lines.style: Resigned but matter-of-fact. No self-pity—just accepting reality. Slight shrug in the delivery, trailing off gently on the end.
